chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Shu'ayb al-Jawhari (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: 'Isa ibn Muhammad al-'Alawi narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan al-Hayri narrated to us in Kufa. He said: Al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-'Urni narrated to us from 'Amr ibn Jami', from 'Amr ibn Abi'l-Miqdam. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said:
These two verses were revealed concerning the people of our wilaya (guardianship) and the people of our enmity:
'As for one who is of those brought near — then relief and satisfaction' — meaning in his grave — 'and the Garden of Bliss' — meaning in the Hereafter.
'And as for one who is of those who belie the truth and are misguided — then his reception will be boiling water' — meaning in his grave — 'and burning in Hell' — meaning in the Hereafter.

key_terms.الْمُقَرَّبِينَ: Those brought near to God; here identified as those who accept the Imams' wilaya
key_terms.رَوْح وَرَيْحَان: Relief and satisfaction (Quran 56:89); interpreted as comfort in the grave (barzakh)
key_terms.عَدَاوَتِنَا: Those who bear enmity toward the Imams; contrasted with the people of wilaya
key_terms.وَلَايَتِنَا: Wilaya — the guardianship, authority, and love of the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt; a central concept in Shia theology

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the verses of Surah al-Waqi'a and wilaya?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) interprets Quran 56:88-94 as referring to those who accept the wilaya (guardianship/authority) of the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt and those who oppose them. Those who accept wilaya receive comfort in the grave (barzakh) and paradise in the Hereafter, while those who oppose it receive punishment in both realms. This narration reflects the Shia theological understanding that acceptance of the Imamate is a condition for salvation, and it connects eschatological outcomes directly to one's stance toward the authority of the Imams.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Shu`ayb al-Jawhari (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Isa b. Muhammad al-`Alawi narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. al-Hasan al-Hayri narrated to us in Kufa. He said: Al-Hasan b. al-Husayn al-`Urni narrated to us from `Amr b. Jami` from `Amr b. Abi’l Miqdam. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said:
These two verses were revealed for the people of our wilaya and our enemies,
“Thus, then, if he is of those brought near, then relief and satisfaction” – meaning, in his grave, “and the Paradise of Bliss” (56:88-89) – meaning, in the Hereafter
– “and if he is of those who bely the truth and are misguided, then he will be in boiling water” – meaning, in his grave – “burning in Hell” (56:92-94) – meaning, in the Hereafter.
